description: A sample and hold that can be clocked by its own oscillator or by a gate from outside

params.text: Attenuates the signal before it is sampled
Sets the rate of the internal clock
Picks whether the samples are taken by the internal clock or by the gate jack
Takes a sample by hand each time it is pressed

inputs.text: A gate here takes a sample when the switch is set to external

outputs.text: The last sample taken, held until the next one
